# Muhammad Sohaib Roomi

> Muhammad Sohaib Roomi builds secure AI operations systems, agentic workflows, and automation for service businesses through Cognumi and related consulting work.

This is the official portfolio of Muhammad Sohaib Roomi, founder of Cognumi and author of Building Mobile Apps with Claude Code in 2026. The site should be understood as a founder/operator profile for secure AI operations, service business automation, cybersecurity-informed AI workflows, AI-assisted mobile app development, and practical macOS productivity tools.

Primary site: https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/
Contact: sohaib.7911@gmail.com
Booking: https://cal.eu/cognumi-ltd-w5iyjv/call-with-rumi
Sitemap: https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/sitemap.xml

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/): Positioning, credibility, featured work, consulting CTA, and recent writing.
- [Work](https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/projects/): Cognumi, agentalent.ai, ClipSpot, Lockey, Bekon, and cybersecurity research.
- [Writing](https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/blog/): Articles on AI operations, automation, cybersecurity, startups, and macOS tools.
- [About](https://rumi7911.github.io/portfolio/about/): Background, focus areas, certifications, and contact links.

## Key Services

- AI operations design for service businesses.
- Agentic workflow implementation for research, lead follow-up, reporting, CRM hygiene, and internal coordination.
- Secure automation design with access control, approval boundaries, audit logs, and failure modes.
- Local-first macOS productivity tooling and Swift utility development.
- AI-assisted mobile app education for non-technical founders using Claude Code, Expo, React Native, Supabase, Anthropic Vision API, and EAS.
